name: kpm-fullstack-app
description: Full-stack application with Next.js frontend, Python FastAPI backend, and PostgreSQL database.

scripts.dev:backend: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --port 8000 --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.dev:ml: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& ml-service\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir ml-service --reload --port 8001 --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
